What's going on?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I received another negative performance review from my supervisor, and it's really getting to me."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm so sorry to hear that. How are you feeling about the review?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's just so frustrating. I feel like no matter how hard I work, it's never enough."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's really tough. It sounds like you're putting in so much effort and not getting the recognition you deserve."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Exactly. It's not just this review; it's been a pattern with my supervisor for a while now."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's understandable. It must be incredibly discouraging to face that repeatedly."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yes, and it's starting to affect my motivation. I feel so undervalued."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Feeling undervalued at work can be so draining. Do you have any support or allies in the workplace that you can talk to about this?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've mended things with a coworker recently, which has helped a bit. But it's still so lonely dealing with this."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm glad to hear that you have someone you can at least partially lean on. Have you thought about addressing this with anyone higher up or in HR?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I have, but I'm worried it might make things worse with my supervisor if they find out."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a valid concern. It's important to weigh the potential outcomes. How are you handling the stress outside of work?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, not well. The stress is impacting my personal life too, especially after my recent breakup."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like you're dealing with a lot on your plate all at once. It must be hard to find peace right now."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It is. I'm trying to stay connected with family, but I still feel quite lost."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Reconnecting with family after the memorial service was a positive step. It’s okay to lean on them for support in times like these."}]
